high_level_description: The image depicts a person taking a selfie at an outdoor café or restaurant. The individual is wearing a black sweatshirt adorned with colorful illustrations of two women's faces, one with long brown hair and the other with short blonde hair. The sweatshirt also features various decorative elements such as flowers, hearts, and lightning bolts. The setting appears to be a European city, as indicated by the architecture of the buildings in the background. The café has several tables and chairs made of wood and metal, and there are potted plants on some of the tables.
